title: DeliveryFlowStages
description: JSON Schema for delivery-flow/references/stages.yml — validates all 7 stage definitions.

stages.description: Ordered list of pipeline stage definitions (id 1..7).

runs_for.description: Project types for which this stage executes at full depth.

skipped_for.description: Project types for which this stage is skipped entirely.

light_for.description: Project types for which this stage runs at light depth.

primary_agent.description: Primary agent role(s) invoked for this stage.

dod_validators.description: Roles that must each return DONE for the stage to complete.

output_path.description: Primary artifact output path or directory for this stage.

output_files.description: Specific artifact file paths produced by this stage.

max_self_correction.description: Maximum number of self-correction iterations before escalation.

human_checkpoint.description: Human checkpoint label, or null if no checkpoint for this stage.

collaboration_patterns.description: Collaboration patterns that execute in this stage.

light_mode_rules.description: Conditions determining when light depth applies, or null.

game_dev_additions.description: Additional agents/checks injected when project type is GAME_DEV+.

dod_status_options.description: Valid DoD status values for this stage (default: [DONE, NOT_DONE]).

notes.description: Free-form notes for orchestrator behaviour at this stage.
